settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_TRUST_ANCHORS
settings.description: This entity's superiors, comma-separated, published as its authority_hints; with PingFederate's own issuer in the list it is an anchor instead and publishes trust_mark_issuers and trust_mark_owners

when_wrong.detail: Unset or blank: the federation servlet does not start

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_SUBORDINATES
settings.description: Entities this one vouches for, comma-separated: /federation/fetch issues a statement about each with the keys its own configuration publishes, and /federation/list lists them

when_wrong.detail: A bad entry fails when it is fetched

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_SIGNING_ALG
settings.description: How this entity signs its statements, with PingFederate's current RSA key

when_wrong.detail: Anything but RS256 or PS256, exactly: the federation servlet does not start

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_ORGANIZATION_NAME
settings.description: organization_name in this entity's federation_entity metadata

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_CLIENT_REGISTRATION_TYPES
settings.description: What client_registration_types_supported advertises, comma-separated; federation_registration_endpoint is published only with explicit. Advertising only: registration works whatever it says

when_wrong.detail: Unknown values are published as given

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_RESOLVE_DISCOVERY
settings.description: Who the resolve endpoint answers for: known, only this entity, its subordinates and the entities it hosts (18.1); any, anyone

when_wrong.detail: Anything but known or any, in any case: the federation servlet does not start

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_ATTESTER_JWKS
settings.description: The co-hosted attester's public keys, published as oauth_client_attester.jwks so other authorisation servers can trust its attestations through the federation

when_wrong.detail: Not a JWK Set, or a key that is not public: the federation servlet does not start

settings.name: trustControllerHost
settings.description: Read and kept, and nothing uses it: the trust controller is OIDF_FEDERATION_TRUST_CONTROLLER_HOST's, which is read here from the environment when this is unset

settings.name: ignoreSslErrors
settings.description: Whether the federation servlet's own fetches (resolve, Trust Mark status) skip certificate checks, for a test federation only; unset, OIDF_FEDERATION_IGNORE_SSL_ERRORS is read here from the environment, without its system property or superseded name (F-0197)

when_wrong.detail: Anything but true, in any case, means false

settings.name: corsEnabled
settings.description: Whether every federation endpoint sends CORS headers

when_wrong.detail: Anything but true, in any case, means false

settings.name: corsAllowOrigin
settings.description: Access-Control-Allow-Origin on the federation endpoints

settings.name: corsAllowMethods
settings.description: Access-Control-Allow-Methods on the federation endpoints

settings.name: corsAllowHeaders
settings.description: Access-Control-Allow-Headers on the federation endpoints

settings.name: corsMaxAge
settings.description: Access-Control-Max-Age on the federation endpoints, in seconds

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number: the federation servlet does not start

settings.name: tokenEndpointAuthMethodsSupported
settings.description: token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported in the openid_provider metadata, comma-separated

settings.name: clientAttestationSigningAlgValuesSupported
settings.description: client_attestation_signing_alg_values_supported in the openid_provider metadata, comma-separated

settings.name: clientAttestationPopSigningAlgValuesSupported
settings.description: client_attestation_pop_signing_alg_values_supported in the openid_provider metadata, comma-separated

settings.name: dpopSigningAlgValuesSupported
settings.description: dpop_signing_alg_values_supported in the openid_provider metadata, comma-separated

settings.name: clientAttestationFormatsSupported
settings.description: Read and kept, comma-separated, and never published

settings.name: clientAttestationPopMethodsSupported
settings.description: The attestation proof-of-possession methods the openid_provider metadata advertises, comma-separated

settings.name: attestationChallengeEndpointEnabled
settings.description: Whether the openid_provider metadata advertises the attestation challenge endpoint

when_wrong.detail: Anything but true, in any case, means false
